title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-08-01 20:36:00 最新章节：第2662章 三百条冰火圣纹
content_zh:
第1章开局成为女帝炉鼎！
“林尘，我给你最后一次机会考虑，要不要与我双修！”
一位绝美女子，坐在溪边。
远处青山秀美，流水叮咚，四周有一片灰蒙蒙的雾气，景色看不真切，仿若梦幻。
她名为玲珑女帝，眉目如画，肤若凝脂，头戴凤冠，身披金色凤袍，腰间系着一根玉带，身材极好，小蛮腰盈盈一握，修长白皙的双腿在林尘眼前晃动，小脚泡在溪水之中，闪闪发光。
“不必考虑了，我拒绝！”
林尘，年方十四，血气方刚，面对绝美女帝诱惑，很难不心动。
但若与女帝双修，林尘恐怕会被榨干，凄惨而死！
而且，林尘是有未婚妻的，此事必须拒绝！
“很好！”
玲珑女帝说完，突然一把按住林尘，将其压在身下。
“你干嘛……”
林尘刚想说话，玲珑女帝的樱桃红唇就贴了上来。
林尘剧烈挣扎，但毫无办法，眼睁睁看着玲珑女帝撕烂他的衣物。
“我都拒绝了，你这女人没点羞耻心吗？”
“你不与我双修，我就与你双修，有问题吗？有问题给我闭嘴！”
玲珑女帝霸道无比，为所欲为。
林尘眼前有大片雪白不断晃动，沉重的压力，让他喘不过气来。
“啊……”
玲珑女帝粉面通红，解开了凤袍，娇躯扭动，如痴如醉！

她是帝境强者，实力强大无比，曾以一己之力在域外对抗天魔族十万大军，将其全灭。
但，那一战，玲珑女帝也受了重伤，身中魔阴毒，一直无法治愈，再拖延下去，会有性命之忧。
林尘的神龙体至刚至阳，可以助她化解魔阴毒，恢复部分实力，甚至更进一步，突破往日巅峰！
溪水边，凤袍、玉带、腿环，各种女子衣物首饰散落一地，水花四溅。
玲珑女帝发出粗重的喘息声，热情如火，溪水打湿了她的娇躯，完美曲线一览无余，远处的草木都在剧烈摇晃。
……
三个时辰后。
溪边有一滩血迹，场面凌乱无比。
林尘苏醒过来，刚睁开眼，便看到一张精致绝美的脸。
玲珑女帝仍旧坐在他身上，脸色微红，眼眸如水，浑身散发出强大的气息。
刚才一番交流，玲珑女帝似乎更强了！
“小家伙，现在你有两个选择，第一，留下来，第……”
“我选第二！”
玲珑女帝还没说完，林尘直接插嘴。
“选第二，你需要完成三件事，若完不成，就算今日放你离去，日后我还是会将你抓回来。”
“哪三件事？”
“第一件事，再来一次！”
玲珑女帝拿捏住了林尘的命脉，媚眼如丝，竟然还想索取！
“不行！
你干脆杀了我吧！”

林尘浑身一个激灵，虽然刚才很爽，但他感觉腰隐隐作痛，浑身难受。
“逗你呢，你想要，我还不乐意，你不会真把我当成随便的女人了吧。”
玲珑女帝轻哼一声，两腿紧了紧，心中暗骂，明明自己修为比他高那么多，为什么事后自己差点站不起来。
林尘目光看向别处，压根不敢和玲珑女帝对视，真怕对方再把自己强上一次。
虽然林尘还有一些余力，但也不能无止境消耗！
content_en:
Chapter 1: Become the Empress Cauldron at the beginning!
"Lin Chen, I'll give you one last chance to consider whether you want to practice dual cultivation with me!"
A beautiful woman was sitting by the stream.
There are beautiful green mountains in the distance, the sound of running water, and a gray mist all around. The scenery is unreal, like a dream.
Her name was Linglong Empress, with picturesque features and creamy skin. She wore a phoenix crown, a golden phoenix robe, and a jade belt around her waist. She had an excellent figure, with a slim waist, and her slender white legs swayed in front of Lin Chen's eyes. Her little feet were soaked in the stream, sparkling.
"Don't think about it, I refuse!"
Lin Chen was fourteen years old and full of vigor. It was hard not to be tempted by the temptation of a beautiful queen.
But if he practices dual cultivation with the Empress, Lin Chen may be squeezed dry and die miserably!
Moreover, Lin Chen has a fiancée, so this matter must be rejected!
"Very good!"
After Empress Linglong finished speaking, she suddenly held Lin Chen down and pinned him down.
"What are you doing..."
Just as Lin Chen was about to speak, Empress Linglong's cherry-red lips pressed against hers.
Lin Chen struggled fiercely, but there was nothing he could do. He watched helplessly as Empress Linglong tore his clothes.
"I refused, don't you, a woman, have any shame?"
"If you don't practice dual cultivation with me, I will practice dual cultivation with you. Is there a problem? If you have a problem, shut up!"
The Linglong Empress is extremely domineering and does whatever she wants.
A large piece of white snow was shaking in front of Lin Chen's eyes, and the heavy pressure made him breathless.
"Ah..."
The empress Linglong's face turned red, she untied her phoenix robe, her delicate body twisted, she was so mesmerized!
She is a powerful person in the Imperial Realm and is extremely powerful. She once single-handedly fought against the 100,000-strong army of the Demon Clan outside the territory and completely destroyed them.
However, in that battle, Empress Linglong was also seriously injured, and she was infected with demonic poison that could not be cured. If she continued to delay, her life would be in danger.
Lin Chen's divine dragon body is extremely strong and yang, which can help her resolve the evil poison, restore some of her strength, and even go one step further, breaking through to her previous peak!
By the stream, phoenix robes, jade belts, leg rings, and various women's clothing and jewelry were scattered on the ground, with water splashing everywhere.
The Linglong Empress breathed heavily, her passion was like fire, the stream wet her delicate body, her perfect curves were visible at a glance, and the vegetation in the distance was shaking violently.
…
Three hours later.
There was a pool of blood beside the stream, and the scene was extremely messy.
Lin Chen woke up and as soon as he opened his eyes, he saw an exquisite and beautiful face.
Empress Linglong was still sitting on him, her face was reddish, her eyes were like water, and she exuded a powerful aura.
After the exchange just now, Empress Linglong seems to be stronger!
"Little guy, now you have two choices. First, stay, and second..."
"I choose second!"
Before Empress Linglong could finish speaking, Lin Chen directly interrupted.
"Choose second. You need to complete three things. If you can't complete it, even if I let you go today, I will still capture you in the future."
"What three things?"
"First thing, do it again!"
Empress Linglong had Lin Chen's lifeline in her hands, her eyes were as charming as silk, and she actually wanted to ask for it!
"No!
You might as well kill me! "
Lin Chen's whole body trembled. Although he felt great just now, he felt a dull pain in his waist and felt uncomfortable all over.
"I'm just teasing you. You want it, but I'm not happy with it. You don't really think of me as a random woman, do you?"
Empress Linglong snorted softly, tightened her legs, and cursed in her heart. She was obviously so much higher than him in cultivation, why could she almost not stand up afterwards.
Lin Chen looked away, not daring to look into the eyes of Empress Linglong, as he was really afraid that the other party would try to force him up again.
Although Lin Chen still has some remaining energy, he cannot consume it endlessly!
